China Sourcing

From selection to sourcing to delivery, our team helps you through it.

We travel to China to discover what's new in furniture and design, meet manufacturers and explore collections you may not easily find back home.

And you don't have to wait for us to bring the collection to you.

Come along with us.

Explore some of China's leading furniture markets and manufacturers, see collections at the source, experience the latest designs, materials and finishes, and choose what you want for your home.

Our team takes care of the sourcing and helps you through the process, so you get access to a much bigger world of design without having to figure it all out yourself.

Or, Shop Straight From Our Catalogues.

Can't travel with us? You can still explore beyond what you see at the Dispazio Experience Studio.

Browse our extended catalogues, discover more furniture, styles and finishes from our sourcing network, and tell us what catches your eye.

We'll help bring your choice from China to your home.

Our Philosophy

Italian Living,
in Hyderabad

Di Spazio was born from a belief that truly exceptional furniture should not require a flight to Milan. We bring the finest Italian design sensibilities directly to Hyderabad — curated pieces that carry the soul of Italian craftsmanship, available at smarter pricing.

Every piece in our showroom is selected for its honesty of form, quality of material, and longevity of design. From curved sofas to statement armchairs, each object is made to become part of your family's story.
